All meal swipes are ready to use with your I-Card. If you are on a meal swipes-per-week plan, your number of weekly swipes will reset every Monday morning. Blaze plan users can use their swipes throughout the semester. In addition to using swipes at the dining halls, residential meal plans with meal exchanges let you use a select

ning halls, residential meal plans with meal exchanges let you use a select number of swipes on designated menu items at participating retail locations. Flames Fare balances carry over from the fall to spring semester and from spring to summer session. Please note that Flames Fare expires at the end of Summer Session II; all u

Please note that Flames Fare expires at the end of Summer Session II; all unused Flames Fare will be forfeited. You can view all locations that accept Flames Fare [here](https://uicdining.sodexomyway.com/en-us/locations/). Guest Passes: All residential meal plans that offer guest passes include a set number each semester.
